q1_issues.issue: (MoreBy stroke par sk_score_1 8 stroke) introduces `par`, a referent that appears nowhere in the text and gets no typing atom, and fills MoreBy's scale slot with the unit `stroke` instead of a lemmatized dimension or adjective.
(Measure sk_score_1 score 64 stroke) supplies the unit `stroke`, which the text never states for the bare numeral "64".

q2_gaps: Clause-level fronted participial adjunct ("Buoyed by ..., Howell shot ..."): the participial rule covers only post-modifiers on a noun (reduced relatives), and no connective atom is licensed for a bare participial adjunct, so the two eventualities are left unrelated.

Object-experiencer psych verbs ("buoyed", and likewise please/frighten/annoy): the role tests assign Experiencer/Stimulus only where the experiencer is the subject, leaving the affected object's role undecided between Patient and Experiencer.
Golf-score NPs: a bare numeral naming a score ("a 64") with a relative-to-par modifier ("8-under") has no licensed encoding for the number, its implicit unit, or the elided standard.
notes: The mass partitive "some of the advice" (Member/PartOf/ProportionOf) and the passive reduced relative "imparted by Nicklaus" follow the instruction set precisely, and (Over sk_lead_1 kenny_perry) is the licensed entity-attached argument preposition on a noun.
